notes:
Account overview: enterprise legal/compliance vendor focused on enterprise counsel + external law firms. Heavy emphasis on immutable audit trails and retention policy enforcement. Customer has ~25M documents (mixed PDFs, TIFFs, email PSTs) across on-prem repositories and AWS S3; expects index growth to ~40M documents by year-end.

Discovery notes (shorthand):
- Prioritized: accurate recall for e-discovery + provable chain-of-custody.
- Wants hybrid retrieval: embeddings index + BM25 prefilter then rerank with cross-encoder.
- "If we can't prove retention and immutable audit logs we can't go forward" — Head of Privacy on call.
- Budget sensitivity on per-query cost; target <$0.02 per user query at 95th percentile.

Technical constraints:
- Must deploy inside VPC or on-prem for regulated clients; no traffic egress to public internet for indexed material.
- Retention policy: 7 years for processed vectors, immutable append-only audit logs for all inference calls.
- SSO via SAML IdP (Okta), SCIM provisioning required.
- KMS integration mandatory for key wrapping (customer-managed keys).

POC ask: 2-week VPC POC to validate embedding throughput, rerank tail latency, and audit log fidelity. Request: sample 5M doc index + 1M query replay, measure 95p latency and cost per query.

Notes on procurement: procurement expects legal + infosec sign-off; procurement timeline ~May-June 2026.

use_case_summary:
Primary: Legal document discovery / compliance RAG. Ingest heterogeneous sources (file shares, legacy DMS, enterprise email). Build embeddings index for semantic recall and run a lightweight BM25 prefilter followed by cross-encoder reranker for evidence ranking. Need provenance metadata attached to every retrieved chunk.
Scale: initial 5-25M documents, multi-year growth to ~40M. Expect 200-300 concurrent search sessions during high-load windows (litigation events).
performance_targets:
Latency targets: 95th percentile end-to-end search (prefilter + embedding search + rerank) < 400ms for single-user workflows; bulk batch reranks (bulk review) can be higher but must support throughput 200 qps for embeddings lookups.
Cost targets: target <$0.02 per interactive query (including embedding lookup + rerank) by using quantized models, batching and prefix caching. Open to Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
Indexing window: full reindex should complete within 48-72 hours for 25M docs using dedicated capacity.
security_summary:
Retention: enforce 7-year retention for vectors and 10 years for audit logs in immutable storage; legal requires chain-of-custody export on demand.
Audit logging: every inference request must be logged with requester id, route/model version, input hash, timestamp, and retrieval provenance. Logs must be exportable and tamper-evident.
Access controls: SSO (SAML), SCIM for groups, RBAC for query/view/export rights. KMS integration and optional HSM for key material.
Compliance asks: provide ISO27001 docs (they requested), answers to vendor risk checklist, and sample immutable log format.
poc_details:
Scope: 2-week VPC-delivered POC.
Setup: dedicated VPC peering, SAML test IdP, sample dataset (5M docs) uploaded to customer S3, index built in private deployment.
Success metrics: 95p latency <400ms on interactive queries; rerank precision (P@10) improvement >20% vs BM25 baseline on their eval set; audit log completeness validated (no missing entries across 72-hour replay).
Deliverables: POC report, pricing estimate for Dedicated + Private deployment, recommendations from Redwood Optimize (quantization, batching profiles).
